items.label: Chew-Resistant and Sturdy
items.value: Constructed with 0.4” thick steel tubes and selected particleboard, this piece of dog crate furniture is sturdier and more chew-resistant than wire and wooden dog crates. The top provides additional storage space to place pet supplies and other decors. The maximum support weight of the top is 154 lbs

items.label: Sliding Door Design
items.value: The dog kennel furnitureadopts a sliding door for effortless operation with a simple push and pull, facilitating easy access for your dog. With 3 quality latches, it provides a cozy and reassuring place for your dog to frolic and play

items.label: Multifunctional Dog Kennel
items.value: This furniture-style dog kennel furniture serves not only as a cozy abode for small to medium-sized dogs but also doubles as a functional side end table with a spacious top for displaying various decor, functional and aesthetic

items.label: Grey Style
items.value: The greige and black tone exudes classic elegance. The 3-sided thickened metal round tubes are well-arranged to create a touch of geometric beauty, captivating your attention and enabling this dog cage to fit into various home decors

items.label: Easy Installation
items.value: This large dog crate furniture comes with the necessary accessories, clear instructions, and accompanying tools. Follow the steps, and you can finish the assembly quickly, creating a cozy and beautiful home for your beloved pet
